title: I’m Only Sleeping wins Grammy Award for Best Music Video | 2024
content:
The official video for The Beatles’ 1966 song ‘I’m Only Sleeping’ has won the Grammy Award for Best Music Video.

The 66th Annual Grammy Awards took place at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, USA.

Congrats Best Music Video winner – "I'm Only Sleeping" (@thebeatles). #GRAMMYs ?

WATCH NOW ?? https://t.co/OuKk34kvdu

— Recording Academy / GRAMMYs (@RecordingAcad) February 4, 2024

The video for ‘I’m Only Sleeping’ was directed by artist Em Cooper, who painted every frame in oil paint over a period of many months. It premiered on The Beatles’ YouTube channel on 1 November 2022.

Page last updated: 21 February 2024
